DeterminationBasis: T16-010 requires the specific property being claimed to remain explicit or unambiguous, while T16-001 requires the claim to name or unambiguously preserve its evaluated scope and evidence basis. Applied to a proof-level claim, these controls preserve the bounded property and evaluated scope to which the proof level applies. A separate test definition is therefore not required for PROOF-001.

T16-004 preserves uncertainty when the required proof level cannot be established, and T16-001 preserves the evidence basis of a claim. Neither requires a PL3 claim or PL3 record to identify the procedure used as well as the evidence used. PROOF-005 therefore remains a distinct proof-level procedure-and-evidence identification obligation.
